notes: The italic and between the two ad phrases is added under rule 14's closing sentence: the Hebrew juxtaposes the phrases with no conjunction morpheme, and each ad already holds the unto written for it.
Both miqshah units head on beaten by rule 31's subtraction (work alone is any work); the second carries the verbless clause's copula while the explicit pronoun hiw takes only its own it (rule 20).
The assimilated article of ka-mmareh is a real token and takes the written the (rule 12), while the preposition takes the compound according unto as one rendering (rule 30).
